identity.name: Chronomat B01 42

case.bezel: unidirectional ratcheted bezel with rider tabs

identity.one_liner: The 42mm steel core of Breitling's rider-tab chronograph line, redesigned in 2020 around the in-house B01 movement.

narrative.story: The Chronomat was introduced in 1984, based on a chronograph Breitling developed a year earlier for the Frecce Tricolori, the Italian Air Force's aerobatic display team, giving the model its signature rider-tab bezel and rouleaux bracelet. Breitling redesigned the case in 2020, sharpening its lines and standardizing the range on the in-house B01 chronograph movement.
narrative.collector_notes: The rouleaux bracelet's fitted-link construction makes sizing less forgiving than a standard oyster-style bracelet; check link count and micro-adjustment before buying pre-owned.
